title: National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program; List of Petitions Received
snippet: HRSA is publishing this notice of petitions received under the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (the Program), as required by the Public Health Service (PHS) Act, as amended. While the Secretary of HHS is named as the respondent in all proceedings brought by the filing of petitions for compensation under the Program, the United States Court of Federal Claims is charged by statute with
agencies: Health and Human Services Department, Health Resources and Services Administration
